test_reduce_on_plateau_scheduler: test the reduce_on_plateau scheduler class that reduces learning rate when metric stops improving
test_learning_rate_reduced_after_cooldow: test that learning rate is reduced after the cooldown period is over with patience threshold
test_plateau_count_resets_on_better_valu: test that plateau_count resets to zero when a new best_value is found during update
test_no_reduction_during_cooldown: test that learning rate is not reduced and plateau_count is not incremented during cooldown period
test_no_reduction_at_min_scale: test that learning rate is not reduced further after min_scale threshold has been reached
